headline: West Texas A&M go three matches without a goal
dek: West Texas A&M scored four and kept a clean sheet against Adams State on the opening day, and have not scored since, losing at home to Fort Lewis and away at Colorado Christian and Southern Nazarene. Their eleven goals conceded are matched only by Sul Ross State, who have yet to score at all.
displaced_by: West Texas A&M's third straight scoreless defeat, at Southern Nazarene; Sul Ross State's third match also made the old dek's 'both their matches' false

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Seven different players have scored Midwestern State's twelve goals, and Jose Ortiz has four of them.

wire.line: Oklahoma Christian's unbeaten start is over after defeat at Northeastern State; Midwestern State, Texas A&M International and UT Tyler are the sides yet to lose.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published at all, and no match marked final is missing its score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all three of their matches without scoring, and have conceded eleven.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made twenty-three saves for Sul Ross State and has yet to keep a clean sheet.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Dallas Baptist have won both matches since losing to UT Tyler on the opening night, scoring five and conceding two.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Dante Caffaro has kept two clean sheets in Oklahoma Christian's four matches and conceded four goals.

last_match.line: Oklahoma Christian's first defeat of the season; Newman had been the only side to score against them before it.

next_match.line: Midwestern State have won both matches at home and drawn their only one away so far, at UCCS.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
